desc: Ideation: model constraints as a weighted XOR graph; use component potentials and independent bitwise majority mask optimization.

Implement the complete Python solution: read stdin, build adjacency list, iterative DFS/BFS with XOR potentials, contradiction checking, per-component bit counts, optimal mask selection, and output -1 or the minimized sequence.
Verify edge cases and samples: M=0, isolated vertices, self-loops, parallel edges, inconsistent cycles, ties in bit counts, and large input performance.
